```{r setup-mascot_size, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

```{r mascot_size-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_size")
```

### Size

The ruler marks 24, 72, 160 and 320 pixels; 160 is the default.

```{r mascot_size-ruler, echo = FALSE}
if (in_studio()) shiny::uiOutput("size_ruler") else guide_table(data.frame(
  Pixels = vapply(c(24, 72, formals(mascot::mascot_size)$size, 320),
                  function(size) mascot::mascot_size(size)$size, numeric(1)),
  Reference = c("Minimum", "Small example", "Default", "Large example")
))
```

<div class="pg-callout">

<strong>Small screens.</strong>
small_screen applies at 576 pixels wide or less. Narrow your browser window to see the mascot switch size.
With `small_screen = "auto"`, a floating mascot shrinks to at most 96 pixels; an inline mascot keeps its size.

</div>

```r
mascot_size()
mascot_size(120, small_screen = 72)
mascot_size("30%", small_screen = NULL)
```

```{r mascot_size-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot_size", studio_character)
```
